label: U.S. All Stocks — Point-in-Time
description: Dynamic survivorship-free U.S.-listed common-stock universe. Eligibility is reconstructed at every rebalance from permanent security IDs, historical listings, prices, liquidity, and delisting-inclusive total returns.

costModel.estimator: 10 bps base all-in spread with 2x/3x stress; historical ADV used separately for capacity
costModel.note: Base costs are deliberately conservative and stressed. Capacity uses trailing historical liquidity as of each rebalance; current liquidity is prohibited.

beats_spy.reason: SPY total return over exactly matched dates is the preregistered primary benchmark.

beats_equal_weight.reason: Equal weight is reconstructed from the eligible PIT universe at each rebalance.

pit_membership.reason: Required: date-effective membership, historical entrants/exits, permanent IDs, and delisting returns must all validate.

unavailableReason: Licensed point-in-time security-master and delisted-price data are not installed.
